facts.fact: The Electoral Reform Technical Committee's report to the Electoral Commission of Zambia says Government "has formulated" the National Digital Transformation Strategy, 2023-2027, to establish a coordinated approach to building the digital economy through adoption of digital technologies across all sectors of the economy and to support service delivery and public sector management; it names no approving act or body, and the report's submission date is used as as_of since no date of formulation is given.
The same report states the period of the National Digital Transformation Strategy as 2023-2027, which covers the report's submission date of April 2025. Text public: not stated

systems.tiers: public sector; described as aimed at digitising the public sector

systems.system: National Information and Communication Technology Policy 2023
